title: Machine Learning Models That Integrate Tumor Texture and Perfusion Characteristics Using Low-Dose Breast Computed Tomography Are Promising for Predicting Histological Biomarkers and Treatment Failure
summary: A prospective study used machine learning on low-dose breast CT texture/perfusion features to predict histological biomarkers and treatment failure. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
